steps.content: You wake up.
You reach out your hand, and what you feel is the touch of cold steel. You seem to be locked in a ring-shaped experiment apparatus.
This is a prison cell someone has built especially for you. You try to use the shackles, but notice they've been blocked by some kind of power.
Looking out the glass window on the wall, you see the familiar Parma Ruins.
The apparatuses are visibly worn, old like the ruins, but the young girl is operating them skillfully, as if she's always been conducting experiments here.
Seeing that you've woken up, she only waves at you, then carries on with her operation.

steps.speaker: Drone
steps.content: Cleaning routine, set-up completed...

steps.speaker: Drone
steps.content: Transporting route, set-up completed...

steps.speaker: Drone
steps.content: Solution mixing, in progress, 73% completed. Fully completed in approximately 3 minutes.
Dozens of drones are transporting objects along the route she's set up and cleaning the devices. Everything is working in perfect order.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Alright... The preparation is done. A3, turn off the fractionator and fractionating column.

steps.speaker: Drone
steps.content: Command confirmed, ready to execute.
Before you, Summer has been completely taken over by her thirst for knowledge. She's giving commands to the drones calmly to ensure the smooth execution of the experiment.
You knock hard on the metal prison cell imprisoning you, hoping Summer can free you from it.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Stop struggling, Chief.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: With your power, it's impossible to break it. Moreover, with this thing here... you can't use the shackles on me now.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: I'll let you out when it's time. If you're too bored, have a go at this.
Summer presses a button and an 11x11 Rubik's cube drops before you.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Why? You're the ideal candidate for the inheritance. Don't you know your own worth?

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: This is a necessary step toward the truth, toward saving the world!
In the desolate Parma Ruins, only the mechanical buzz of the drones can be heard.
Like those monsters in the Black Ring?

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: As someone qualified for the inheritance, you don't have to worry about such things.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: If my assumption is correct, nothing's gonna go wrong... Even if you hug it in your arms and give it a kiss.
Summer answers your questions as she mixes solutions of various colors together, gives the mixture a shake, and sets it down.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Amazing, this is the most stable state I've ever seen.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Parma is the right choice, after all.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Hmm? ...You don't even know that, being the Chief of Minos and all?

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: The inheritance was initially stored right here, in the Laboratory of Parma.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: I couldn't find it here back then... But now, my wish is finally coming true!

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Great! I'm a step closer... to the truth.

options: I can't believe you're no different than Parma.

choices.text: I can't believe you're no different than Parma.

steps.content: Has your intention always been... to steal the inheritance?

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Steal? No, no, what an awful way to put it.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: To be honest with you, I don't care where the inheritance is. All I care about is that I get to study the mystery of this inheritance.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Next, we'll test the compatibility of the bearer and this stuff.

steps.speaker: Drone
steps.content: Inspecting experiment environment... Result: Good. Experiment can begin immediately.
Summer is operating the experiment panel, and a pale blue solution starts filling the glass prison cell you're in.
What is this?!

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Oh? This is the inheritance catalyst number three concocted by me. All the raw materials were obtained from regular purchasing channels in the Bureau.
You want to distract Summer and seize this chance to stop her with the shackles, but this proves somewhat difficult for you, having just awoken.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Hey... Relax. For someone like you, this won't be a great burden to your body.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: It may just... hurt a little.
The solution is growing in volume. You feel as though you're back to that boundless abyss, countless hands tearing at you hysterically.
Viscous, painful, and maniacal emotions are pouring into your mind, the origin of the mystery has once again opened its door to you.
But this time there are no terrifying Corpsebornes or sad departures.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: The emotions are stable, prepare to increase the dosage.
The solution keeps increasing. You must think of a way to escape from this glass prison cell. Even if it's for the truth of the world, one shouldn't attempt something like this.
The metal prison cell is unusually hard. It's impossible to break free of it with bare hands.
Your gaze shifts to the Rubik's cube Summer has thrown in. You grip the cube and smash it on the metallic surface.
Sadly, it's only a most ordinary Rubik's cube.
The reaction wrecks it easily and the color cubes shatter everywhere. One piece of it cuts your hand and a small amount of blood drips into the solution.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Chief—Don't attempt any dangerous moves! Just wait patiently!

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Next, it's time to uncover the truth and save the world!
Uncover the truth and save the world...?
That's one of the iconic lines from The Age of Youth.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Come on, come on, come on, come on, come on!

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: The truth... is waving at me on the other side!
You know that Summer wants to replicate the inheritance's initial form through simulation.
And you had the luck to see what was on the other side.
There lies only pain, darkness, and despair.
What's hidden on the side where the inheritance lies may not be the truth.
Suddenly, you hear a fine noise in the massive Petri dish you're in.
The frequency of the noise starts getting faster, and its volume bigger.
As if gaining its own consciousness, the solution is eating through the metal prison cell aggressively.
Visible cracks begin appearing on the incredibly hard steel. The pain plaguing you is also dwindling.

steps.speaker: Drone
steps.content: Warning, pressure in the container is dropping continuously.

steps.speaker: Drone
steps.content: Warning, stability of the container cannot be sustained.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: There are... errors?

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: No way... It shouldn't turn out like this! The solution should have fused with the inheritance and generated new power...

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Again, let me try that again! It shouldn't have turned out like this!

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: I must be able to turn this curse... into infinite energy!
The situation looks just like when Summer hits a bottleneck in the anime.
The inheritance won't bring you the truth. It only brings destruction!

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: No!

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: I was... so close to making it! So close... to making it!
She's panicking and seems helpless, yet she can only keep endeavoring endlessly to search for the unknown truth.
Our little genius seems very troubled.
A familiar voice is echoing on the experiment site.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: How did you find me?
Through those two videotapes, of course. Our genius is still careless as always.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: ...But I've made sure to delete all my records of use.
It's hard to locate you, but it's easy to locate him.
steps.female_content: It's hard to locate you, but it's easy to locate her.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: My patience is limited. Seeing that we were once colleagues, I don't want to harm you.
Not bad, you've become much calmer than before.
Your past self would have already fired at me.
Haha, enough of that.
How about we make a deal? A deal about the truth.
Why, you're not interested?

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Go on.
The initial test on the MBCC's Chief, Parma's remaining members, and the ceaseless reports on the dark web. These three things combined give you nerves, am I right?

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Of course, I'm the hero who's going to save the world. I can't sit back and watch the world go into an even bigger crisis.

options: The world going into a crisis?

choices.text: The world going into a crisis?

steps.content: I've never heard about this.
We're talking about you, my dear Chief. As the bearer of the inheritance, who wouldn't be curious about your body?
That's why the deal is really simple. There's only one term.
Come back to the Research Institute with me, Summer.

In return, I can provide you with protection on behalf of the Research Institute. You'll regain freedom at the same time, no longer trapped in the MBCC's birdcage. And you'll receive way more generous research support.
As for this guy, once we're back, I'll let you study him with state-of-the-art equipment instead of a tacky metal can like this.
steps.female_content: As for this one, once we're back, I'll let you study her with state-of-the-art equipment instead of a tacky metal can like this.

steps.content: Consider my offer, my little genius.
Summer's expression is serious, looking like she's mulling over the man's words.
We've missed the good timing. Right now, the FAC needs his power, and even that old hag at the 9th Agency has her eyes fixed on him. It's hard to get in touch with him through ordinary means.
steps.female_content: We've missed the good timing. Right now, the FAC needs her power, and even that old hag at the 9th Agency has her eyes fixed on her. It's hard to get in touch with her through ordinary means.

steps.content: As he speaks, he sticks out his fingers and gently knocks a couple times on the experiment equipment imprisoning you.
But the Research Institute will find a way to make him disappear, turning him into your permanent research material.
steps.female_content: But the Research Institute will find a way to make her disappear, turning her into your permanent research material.

steps.content: We're all passionate about the truth, but the Research Institute treasures a one-in-a-million genius more.
Summer, did you know? Everyone at the Research Institute... is looking forward to your return! There are many interesting projects waiting for you!
It'll be so much more fun than watching anime in that shabby place all day!
Let him out, we should go now.
steps.female_content: Let her out, we should go now.

steps.content: The mysterious man beckons to Summer.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Laplace, you're still so boring.

steps.speaker: Laplace
steps.content: What did you say...?

steps.speaker: Laplace
steps.content: This time the Research Institute will be fully in charge. Parma's tragedy won't happen again.

steps.speaker: Laplace
steps.content: As long as you come back and make your mark, you'll be the next Keylan, esteemed and praised by all.

steps.speaker: Laplace
steps.content: The process doesn't matter. Once you achieve the right results, you'll be the Hero.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: You're still as shallow as always. Hero to me is not a title or a name.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: It's the one thing that I find the most interesting and must keep living up to!

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: I will find the solution with my own powers. Your Research Institute... Ha, you'd better step aside this time. I will never trust you guys again, ever.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: I will keep fighting and carrying out my own research while sticking to my initial intention.

steps.speaker: Laplace
steps.content: If we pair your formula with the endless seeds in the Research Institute!

steps.speaker: Laplace
steps.content: We'll soon obtain power comparable to that of a Black Ring!

steps.speaker: Laplace
steps.content: Why? Why don't you understand? There are so many more truths waiting for you! Why do you choose to waste your time here?

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Haha, blame it on your wicked tricks. Selling all my research findings to Parma, no hero will make such a despicable act!

steps.speaker: Laplace
steps.content: Fine... fine! Go on lying low, go on being an underachieving loser then! I shall triumph over you, so the world will know that even without Summer... research on the Ring can still continue!

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Isn't that beyond your reach, considering your capability, Laplace?

steps.speaker: Laplace
steps.content: It looks like we've run out of room for talk again, Summer.
The solution filling up to your waist still keeps stimulating the Black Ring fragment in your body, like numerous ants nibbling at your nerves.
You want to stop the conflict between the two as soon as possible. Summer knocks on the container, signaling you to stop.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Just wait for me patiently, Chief.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: A battle is coming up next. It's the safest choice to stay in there.
Before she finishes her sentence, a laser beam is shot toward where you are. But before it touches that cage imprisoning you, it's blocked by Summer's drone.

steps.speaker: Laplace
steps.content: Haha... I'm impressed. Even though our combat team members hasn't carried any metal equipment on them, you've still spotted them.

steps.speaker: Laplace
steps.content: Attention, capture her alive!

steps.speaker: Soldier
steps.content: Understood. Everyone, be sure to control the laser intensity.

steps.speaker: Laplace
steps.content: Come on, show me... just how much your Ring Weapon has improved in the past two years.

steps.speaker: Laplace
steps.content: Fire!
At Laplace's command, countless bullets are sprayed toward Summer.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Activate defensive stance.
At her command, all the drones within the area immediately form an enormous shield before her and you.
Sparks are flying everywhere, and the defensive shell can barely block all the laser beams shooting at you.

steps.speaker: Drone
steps.content: Warning, high temperature detected. Defensive shell will melt in approximately five seconds. Please take cover in time.

steps.speaker: Drone
steps.content: Time remaining: four seconds.

steps.speaker: Soldier
steps.content: Keep firing! She won't last long!

steps.speaker: Drone
steps.content: Time remaining: three seconds.

steps.speaker: Soldier
steps.content: Copy that! Keep up with the attacking rate!

steps.speaker: Drone
steps.content: Time remaining: two seconds.

steps.speaker: Laplace
steps.content: Is this the truth you're after? How ridiculous... You're going to bring shame to the Ring Research Institute.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: So what... if I do? I don't want anything more to do with the Research Institute anymore anyway!

steps.speaker: Drone
steps.content: Time remaining: one second.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: I see that the Research Institute hasn't raised its standards. It's easy to spot a weakness in such an overly regular attack pattern.

steps.speaker: Drone
steps.content: Shield melting, please take cover.
Summer looks fearless and doesn't even react to the drone's severe warning.

steps.speaker: Soldier
steps.content: Has she lost her mind?! How can we capture her alive like this? Cease fire, now!

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Reform battle formation!
The moment the shield melts, Summer gives her command and pushes out the already damaged drones to block the last round of attack.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: A2, A4, A6, A8, A10, switch to attack mode, quit defense formation.

steps.speaker: Drone
steps.content: Command accepted, preparing to change battle strategy.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: B3, B6, B9, B12, switch to tracking mode, prepare to eliminate specific targets.

steps.speaker: Drone
steps.content: Command accepted, preparing to eradicate threats.
The drones begin adjusting their combat forms, locking onto one hidden enemy after another.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Full system locked on, clear area!
With a snap of a finger from Summer, brilliant blue flames shot out from the Ring Weapon.
Boom—
Amid intense explosions, the offense-and-defense dynamic on the battlefield reverses within a second.
Laplace's lackeys have their armor blown away by the immense firepower. Despite having taken over the bunker, they can't resist the intense bombarding by the Ring Weapon.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Yield, Laplace. If you leave now, I can pretend none of this has happened.
Laplace is laughing hysterically, putting on a strange glove. With a wave of his hand, all of Summer's attacks are ceased entirely.

steps.speaker: Laplace
steps.content: Looks like our genius has learned quite a few lame jokes in the Bureau.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: If Parma hadn't been destroyed, you would have become one of them long ago, wouldn't you?

steps.speaker: Laplace
steps.content: Haha, hahaha... Parma? What could I have gotten from Parma?

steps.speaker: Laplace
steps.content: Let me show you the latest technology from the Ring Research Institute! Those Ring Weapons and drones of yours, they are no more than toys in the face of it.

steps.speaker: Laplace
steps.content: I don't want to play hero with you anymore. Recognize the difference in strength between you and us, and come back, Summer.
A brilliant blue light is gathering in Laplace's palm. You sense danger instinctively.
After he's put on that glove, all you can feel from Laplace is... a fear that can destroy everything.
Just like what you felt in that battle with the Corpseborne.
You look at Summer. Under his attack, there won't be any chance of survival even if Summer fights back with all her might.
The only hope is to use the shackles to amplify Summer's ability so she can resist Laplace's attack.
The entrance to the abyss, the origin of mysteries, the beginning of disasters. What actually lies there? You close your eyes gently, feeling the guidance your body receives.
The truth is right before your eyes, yet you can't reach it. It's quiet under the dead silence.
You finally activate the shackles successfully. The blue solution has brought you endless suffering, but it's also given you unimaginable power.
The shackles pierce through the solution and split into countless blood-red thorns, spreading from the metal container covered in cracks.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Chief... You...
Noticing the sudden changes behind her, Summer scrambles over to stop you.
But the power no longer brings you pain. It reassures you instead.
No haggard figures, no painful emotions, only power in its purest form.
It passes through the steel and firmly connects to Summer.
Unlike extremely painful emotions, it doesn't long to devour, doesn't crave each other, and doesn't thirst for blood, flesh, or souls. It simply exists.
It wants to help others, wants to become their hero.
It's the purest emotion, as well as part of Summer's truth.
Only, sustaining this state is extremely demanding on your spirit.
You force yourself to steady the shackles and give Summer your final order.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Humph, I knew it. How will my truth possibly be defeated?
The shackles pierce through the solution and split into countless blood-red thorns, spreading from the metal container covered in cracks.

But the power no longer brings you pain. It reassures you instead.
No haggard figures, no painful emotions, only power in its purest form.
It passes through the steel and firmly connects to Summer.
Unlike extremely painful emotions, it doesn't long to devour, doesn't crave each other, and doesn't thirst for blood, flesh, or souls. It simply exists.
It wants to help others, wants to become their hero.
It's the purest emotion, as well as part of Summer's truth.
Only, sustaining this state is extremely demanding on your spirit.
You force yourself to steady the shackles and give Summer your final order.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Humph, I knew it. How will my truth possibly be defeated?
Summer turns back and smiles at you.

steps.speaker: Laplace
steps.content: Those bizarre tricks of yours... are no match for the great invention by the Ring Research Institute! Hahahaha...

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: No wonder the battle scenes were so poorly made in the second episode... You can't even imagine how I'd look when I destroy Parma.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: This time, take a good look at how I butcher a whole team of villains on my own, and do a remake when you get back!
The two sides pull the triggers at the same time. The blinding light forces you to keep your eyes shut.
